name: Nanya Technology Corporation
blurb: Nanya Technology is Taiwan's second-largest DRAM maker, operating a 60,000-wafer-per-month fab in Taioyuan that focuses on commodity DDR4 and specialty DRAM. Unlike Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, Nanya has not pursued high-bandwidth memory (HBM), positioning it as a late-cycle beneficiary: as the three majors redirect wafer capacity toward AI-stacked memory, Nanya fills the resulting gap in conventional DRAM supply at sharply higher prices.
recent: In Q1 2026, Nanya reported a 583% year-on-year revenue surge to NT$49 billion, with a gross margin of 68% and net income of NT$26 billion — the best quarter in the company's history. Average selling prices rose more than 70% quarter-on-quarter as DDR4 tightened dramatically. Management guided Q2 2026 ASPs to rise further 'in the few tens of percent' range. The company is advancing DDR5 transition (16Gb DDR5-5600 now at roughly 10% of shipments) and progressing 1C/1D-nanometre process development on schedule.
